lib.empty.title: Veg er ny gheddyn
lib.empty.text: Prow ennym elley ny lhig da “Taishbynee gamanyn gyn exe”.
fav.title: Reihyn
fav.empty.title: Veg ayns shoh foast
fav.empty.text: Broo yn rollage er leacag gamman dy chur ayns shoh eh.
detail.duration: Kead cha liauyr dy reayll eh
detail.finding: Shirrey son coip soit jeh'n ghamman…
detail.notInstalled: Cha nel coip soit er ny gheddyn, as t'eh shen kiart: cha nel feme ec y decoy er nane.
detail.noteDone: Foddys oo stad y chur er nish, lhisagh y quest ve coontit.
detail.noteRunning: Ta'n obbraghey goll 'sy chooylrey. Foddys oo jean sloo yn uinnag dys y treiy.
detail.noExe.title: Cha nel exe y ghamman shoh er fys ec Discord foast
detail.noExe.text: Cha nod eh ve feddynit liorish obbraghey. Broo “Noaee yn bun-fysseree” ny s'anmey: tra ta Discord cur exe rish, bee yn gamman ry-gheddyn.
running.title: Goll
running.none: Cha nel veg goll kiart nish
running.empty.title: Cha nel veg goll
running.empty.text: Foshil gamman 'sy lioarlan as broo “Cur er bun decoy”.
settings.title: Reaghaghyn
settings.language.desc: Çhengey eddyr-eaghtyr. Ta çhengaghyn noa currit rish myr coadanyn 'sy choodagh locales.
settings.defaultTime.desc: Kwoad dy villidyn dy reayll y pròiseas. She 16 yn bun-reaghys, cha nel 15: ta cuirraghyn Discord shirrey 15 minnid dy chloie, agh ta Discord feme seose gys minnid dy chronnaghey cloie noa, myr shen ta 15 dy jeeragh ro ghiare.
settings.smartTimer.desc: Ta'n coontey sheese toshiaghey tra ta Discord er chronnaghey y decoy, cha nel tra t'ou toshiaghey eh. Dy hoiggal shen, cha nel yn app lhaih agh ny linaghyn bentyn rish y chloie ta roie ass lioar-chooishyn ynnydagh Discord; cha nel veg tashtit ny currit gys boayl erbee.
settings.autoUpdate.desc: Jeeagh er GitHub ec toshiaght as dagh 6 ooryn as laadey neose lhiegganyn noa 'sy chooylrey. Ta cur stiagh feitheamh er dty hickyraghey dy kinjagh, as ta feeraghey jeant er coadanyn lesh nyn saie-screeuyn bun-earrooagh.
update.ready: Ta lhieggan {v} aarloo dy chur stiagh
detail.waitingNote: Ta Discord feme seose gys minnid dy chronnaghey cloie. Ta'n coontey sheese toshiaghey tra t'eh fakin y decoy.
detail.assumed: Cha nel Discord er hickyraghey eh, ta'n traa goll er coontey co-ordagh.
settings.autoStop.desc: Ta'n decoy kioneaghey liorish hene tra ta'n traa seose.
settings.notify.desc: Fys Windows tra ta'n traa seose.
settings.tray: Jean sloo dys y treiy er dooney
settings.tray.desc: Ta decoyn tannaghtyn goll tra ta'n claare 'sy treiy.
settings.showNoExe.desc: Entryn raad nagh vel yn obbraghey er fys ec Discord foast (cha nod ad ve er nyn goyrd er bun).
settings.dataDir.desc: Raad ta rolley ny gamanyn as reaghaghyn er nyn stoyral.
settings.dataDir.portable: Mod ymmyrkagh: ta dagh ooilley nhee stoyrit liorish decoy.exe.
settings.legal: Cha nel Decoy jannoo ymmyd jeh'n token Discord ayd as cha nel eh goaill rish quests er dty hon. Foddys brynneraghey obbraghey gamman goll noi reillyn Discord, jean ymmyd jeh er dty gaue hene.
toast.launched: Ta “{name}” er ny chur er bun son {n} min. Lhisagh Discord cur tastey da ayns mysh 15 shallidyn.
toast.allStopped: Dagh ooilley decoy er ny stad
toast.timeUp: Ta'n traa seose, lhisagh y quest ve coontit
toast.refreshUpToDate: Ta'n bun-fysseree ass y noa hannah
lab.title: Prowaltys
lab.subtitle: Dullag follit: cur er bun ram decoyn ec un cheayrt.
lab.count: Kead gamman dy chur er bun
lab.count.desc: Ta gamanyn er nyn reih gyn tort, t'ad shen ta goll hannah er nyn skibbaghey. Ta dagh fer goll son {n} min (soit ayns Reaghaghyn).
lab.warn: Ta dagh decoy ny phròiseas er lheh lesh uinnag. Oddys ro-vooar ec yn un traa cur dty cho-earrooder er riojey: ta dagh pròiseas as uinnag jannoo ymmyd jeh cooinaghtyn, as lurg kuse dy villaghyn dy uinnagyn foddee Windows scuirr jeh croo tooilley. My vel oo dooney Decoy, nee dagh decoy scuirr.
lab.risk.mid: Veih mysh 250 decoy er-oaie, foddee Discord hene goll ny s'melley: t'eh lhiantyn rish dagh gamman ta roie as cur fys da ny h-ard-hirveishyn echey.
lab.risk.high: Ghaue: tra va 5,000 decoy currit er bun ec un cheayrt, ren Discord aase harrish 10 GB dy RAM as thuitt eh dagh 30 tullagh derrey va ny fysseree ynnydagh echey aachurrit. Nee Decoy stappal dagh ooilley nhee my vees cooinaghtyn Discord lheimyragh, agh cha nel raantys erbee ayn.
lab.discordRam: Ta Discord jannoo ymmyd jeh {gb} GB dy RAM kiart nish.
lab.unlock.desc: Harrish y derrey shoh ta Discord er vrishey ayns cliaghtey. Cur er bree eh agh ny ta fys ayd er y ghaue.
guard.tripped: Dagh decoy er ny scuirr dy choadey Discord: t'eh jannoo ymmyd jeh {gb} GB dy RAM (seose {grew} GB). My t'eh moal, aahoshee eh.
lab.next: Ta ny gammanyn ayns oardagh lettyragh. Ta'n chied phossan elley toshiaght lesh “{name}”.
lab.estimate: Nee {n} decoy jannoo ymmyd jeh mysh {ram} dy RAM.
lab.limit: Scuirr Windows jeh toshiaghey pròiseasyn noa lurg {n}: shen kagliagh y chorys.
running.more: …as {n} elley. Ta'n chied 120 goll er taishbyney.
notify.title: Ta'n traa seose
